project_info.name: DutchBay Wind Farm
project_info.location: Dutch Bay, Kalpitiya, Puttalam District, Sri Lanka

wake_model: PyWake Bastankhah-Porte-Agel 2014 (Gaussian, k*=0.042): 7.32% for the 14 DutchBay turbines with the Blue Whale turbine at T2 still waking (the 15-turbine 7.28% x the live PyWake ratio 1.0053, #1577, docs/wind/dutchbay_14_turbine_wake_summary.json); TurbOPark cross-check 8.93% (15 turbines, not re-derived)

uncertainty.note: 2.0% pre-construction P50 over-prediction haircut applied to the modelled net P50 (14 turbines: 442.1 -> 433.2; 15 turbines were 473.8 -> 464.3) before the exceedance build-up. WIND-5 (#484) BASIS (de-circularised): the 2% is a conservative POLICY CHOICE grounded in the site-independent, documented pattern that operational P50s run ~2-5% below pre-construction model estimates (the pre-construction over-prediction bias; IEC 61400-15-2 EYA guidance + DNV/operational literature, ~0-7% range) -- NOT derived from this project's own EIA. As an ex-post CONSISTENCY CHECK only, the project's Final EIA (Envision EN220/10.0 EYA) independently reports P50 464.5 GWh for 15 turbines (within ~0.04% of the 15-turbine haircut output; about 433.5 GWh scaled to 14), which corroborates but does not set the 2%. All net P-values scale by 0.98; gross + loss build-up are upstream and unchanged.

notes: 2026-11-08 (#1577): 14 TURBINES. The Blue Whale turbine stands on DutchBay T2 (#1568), and the owner decided DutchBay drops to 14 turbines (T1, T3-T15): 14 x 10.6383 = 148.94 MW, carried as 148.9 MW. Gross 517.2 GWh (14/15 of 554.1), wake 7.28% -> 7.32% (live PyWake ratio on the recorded layout, the turbine at T2 kept in the flow as a waker and out of the energy count; sensitivities 7.15% with T2 removed and 7.24% on the 650 m row), total losses 14.52%, modelled net P50 442.1 -> bankable 433.2 GWh, net CF 0.332. Regenerated with analytics.wind.aep_summary_builder from scenarios/dutchbay_lendercase_2025Q4.yaml. The EN220 EYA's 464.5 GWh is a 15-turbine figure. The text that follows is the 15-turbine history. Net AEP for the 15 x IEA Reference 10MW (198 m, 345 W/m2) re-model via wind_resource.bankable_aep: IEC 61400-12-1 air-density correction (rho 1.15, v-shift x0.979) of the IEA power curve over the ERA5-FITTED Weibull A=8.199/k=2.665 (3-method consensus MLE/MoM/scipy on the 2020-2024 ARCO single-point timeseries at the 150 m hub, r2=0.998); PyWake Bastankhah-Porte-Agel 2014 granular wake = 7.28% (TurbOPark bound 8.93%) over a 15-turbine 650 m row; availability/electrical/curtailment/other = 14.48% total losses; P50/P75/P90 from an IEC 61400-15-2 uncertainty budget (sigma ~10%) -- NOTE: -15-2 is the Energy Yield Assessment part (the loss/uncertainty taxonomy + P-values), an IEC working-group framework still in DRAFT as of 2025; do NOT conflate it with the separately PUBLISHED IEC 61400-15-1:2025, which is the 'site suitability input conditions' part (wind-conditions characterization), not the energy-yield loss/uncertainty taxonomy. 15 x 10.638 = 159.6 MW nameplate, net CF 0.339. RE-BASELINED from the prior DECLARED Weibull A=8.32/k=2.1 (mean 7.85): the declared mean overstated the resource, so net AEP falls 483.6 -> 473.8 GWh (-2.0%). Supersedes the EN-171/6.5 base (402.6 GWh / 0.307, still on the declared Weibull); EN-171 retained as a characterization/sensitivity machine. 2026-06-28: a 2.0% pre-construction P50 over-prediction HAIRCUT is now applied (modelled net 473.8 -> bankable 464.3 GWh, CF 0.339 -> 0.332), corroborated by the project's Final EIA (Envision EN220 EYA) independent P50 464.5 GWh; see the uncertainty block.
